newsitem.title: FINLAND: KYRO SEES HIGHER 1997 OVERALL EARNINGS.
newsitem.headline: KYRO SEES HIGHER 1997 OVERALL EARNINGS.

text.p: Finnish machinery and power group Kyro Oy said on Wednesday its full-year operating profit may fall short of the 1996 level but overall earnings would still rise.

"Despite Tecnomen group's high order backlog, it is possible that, due to its profit development, group operating earnings will be somwhat lower than in 1996," it said in a statement with its January-April report.
"Due to gains from the sale of shares, consolidated overall earnings are however expected to exceed the corresponding earnings in the previous year," it said.
Kyro reported January-April profit before extras rising 79 percent to 50 million markka from 28 million in the year-ago period.

Its first tertial operating profit fell to 10 million from 27 million, but net financial items jumped to 40 million from one million markka on a 44 million markka gain from share disposals, mostly Metsa-Serla B shares, it said.
In 1996, Kyro's operating profit was 104 million markka, its profit before extras was 101 million and its pretax profit was 100 million markka.
